decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already captures the requirement that each selected moment be a full lesson, story, or real point shaped into a standalone clip.
The source collection is independently addressed by an existing same-message MODIFY; the moment-selection standard requires no additional source-selection change.
Requiring substantive lessons, stories, or points does not change the separate requirement to select moments with good hooks.
The 70-85 second duration is already captured by a complete same-message MODIFY and is not further changed by the moment-selection decision.
The substantive-content standard does not alter the separate clean and simple visual-editing rules.
Moment-selection content has no necessary effect on the white-text-only and no-text-effects requirements.
The message describes ongoing monthly production but does not modify or resume the deferred task-local trial-batch requirement.
The daily-output clarification is already captured by a complete same-message MODIFY; the moment-selection standard adds no further quota-state change.
Selecting substantive moments does not change the requirement to use the exact brand-specified font.
The statement that the assigned Instagram account will be sent does not change the existing account type, provisioning method, or posting purpose.
Mentioning Instagram performance bonuses does not change the existing tracked metrics, tracking coverage, or transparency requirement.
